description: This file contains unit tests for the WebAudioPlayer Buffer API, specifically testing buffer management, device info retrieval, and interaction with the GStreamer backend in a media server context. It defines a test fixture class and multiple test cases to verify correct behavior under various scenarios.

classes.name: RialtoServerWebAudioPlayerBufferApiTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for WebAudioPlayer Buffer API tests, inheriting from WebAudioPlayerTestBase. Sets up and tears down the WebAudioPlayer instance, and provides utility methods for test scenarios.

methods.name: writeBufferFailure
methods.description: Helper method to test writeBuffer failure scenario when no buffer can be written.
